note: Literature on ISC biogenesis defects confirms lactate elevations in plasma and CSF are not ubiquitous, with MRS lactate peaks reported in approximately 25% of cases.

evidence.text: In defects of mitochondrial iron-sulfur cluster biogenesis, plasma and CSF lactate can be elevated but this is not ubiquitous, and MRS cerebral lactate peaks are observed in 25% of cases.

source.title: Mitochondrial iron-sulfur cluster biogenesis and neurological disorders
source.quote: Patients can have raised plasma and CSF glycine and lactate, but this is not ubiquitous. … cord lesions prominent in most patients; lactate peaks are seen on MRS in 25% of cases.

numbers.metric: percentage of cases with lactate peaks on MRS

evidence.text: FDXR neuroimaging is typically normal outside of acute episodes, and MR spectroscopy may show a lactate peak in equivocal or decompensated cases affecting basal ganglia or brainstem.

source.title: Neuroimaging in FDXR-related mitochondriopathy
source.quote: MR spectroscopy may be of value in equivocal cases and will classically reveal a markedly elevated lactate peak affecting the basal ganglia or brainstem.
